breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification is merely a clarifying question about the hot water inlet temperature. It does not address or correct the inconsistency where parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in, ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out) were incorrectly specified for a counterflow heat exchanger. The correct counterflow definitions (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out, ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in) are never mentioned.
